Thanks for applying to the Platform Engineer (inference) role — I’m Marissa, the recruiter on this role. I’d love to set up a quick 20-minute phone screen to learn a bit about your background and share the role.

I know evenings can be easier for folks in EMEA, so I wanted to propose a couple of options that should work on both sides of the pond. All times below are listed with a PST / CEST conversion to avoid confusion — please confirm which slot works best for you (or suggest 2–3 alternatives):

• Tue Aug 4 — 5:00 PM PST / Wed Aug 5 — 02:00 AM CEST (this is late — only if you’re flexible)
• Wed Aug 5 — 6:30 PM PST / Thu Aug 6 — 03:30 AM CEST (same note)
• Thu Aug 6 — 8:00 AM PST / Thu Aug 6 — 17:00 CEST (early morning for us, evening for you)

If those are awkward, feel free to send your availability window in CEST and I’ll match it. When we confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite (20 minutes) and loop in Jordan Blake, the hiring manager, to join.

Also — could you attach a copy of your most recent resume if you have it handy?

Thanks,
